 Learn more about The Real Housewives of London cast member, Karen Loderick-Peace, after her Season 2 reunion read went viral.
 By Casey Suglia Nov 18, 2026, 11:44 AM ET Catch The Real Housewives of London Season 1 Trailer! Now Playing 2:44 Preview Catch The Real Housewives of London Season 1 Trailer! Share this on Reddit Share this on Facebook Share this on X Share this by Email Share this by SMS Copy link Add us on Google Key Takeaways
 The Real Housewives of London's Karen Loderick-Peace gained attention for defending her property portfolio, stating she owns five properties across London, Jersey, and Staffordshire.
 Originally from Jamaica, Karen shared at the Season 2 reunion that she moved to England at 25. She runs the fashion label called Becuz, while also being a busy mom and wife.
 Karen is married to businessman and former West Bromwich Albion chairman Jeremy Peace, and the couple shares three children, with her husband and two daughters appearing in support of her on the series.
 Karen Loderick-Peace is a cast member on The Real Housewives of London who is fiercely loyal to defending the several homes that she owns all over the world and her recent The Real Housewives of London Season 2 reunion read has gone viral.
 How to Watch
 The Real Housewives of London is streaming now on Peacock.
 Stream on In a clip from The Real Housewives of London Season 2 reunion, posted to TikTok , Karen can be seen talking about her homes with RHOLDN cast member Amanda Cronin . "I live in a mansion in Belgravia; you live in a mews home, Amanda," she said in the clip. "I own every single property I have. And that's why you're jealous."
 Although Amanda told Karen that she lives in a "tiny townhouse" and that she can "fit her house in my kitchen," Karen was not having it. "I own Chelsea, I own Belgravia, and I own two in Jersey. What do you own? One property," Karen said. "I'm from Jamaica, a little girl from the countryside. And I came to England at 25 years old. And I own five properties. And you come to England, you sleep with princes, you sleep with Lords, you sleep with mayors. You sleep with this, you sleep with that, and you only have one mews house."

 (For those wondering, mews homes are historic former carriage houses and stables that have been converted into residences.)
 Karen Loderick-Peace at The Real Housewives of London reunion on October 14, 2026 in London, England.
 Photo: Laura Rose/Dave Benett/Getty Images for Hayu Read on to learn more about Karen, her homes, and how to watch her on RHOLDN.  
 How many homes does Karen Loderick-Peace own?
 Karen owns five properties, including one in the Chelsea neighborhood and Belgravia neighborhood in London. She also owns two properties in Jersey, one of the Channel Islands located in the English Channel. Karen and her husband own an additional house in Staffordshire, according to The Standard .

 Who is Karen Loderick-Peace from The Real Housewives of London ?
 Karen, according to an announcement for The Real Housewives of London Season 1 , is pursuing her dreams and isn't afraid of a little confrontation. "As her children fly the nest, Karen returns to London to finally pursue her dream of launching her own fashion label, Becuz. But, reestablishing herself in the city's social scene proves challenging — with whispered rumors, shifting alliances, and loyalty constantly under scrutiny. Peace is hard to find when you're caught between clashing Housewives in a group that questions your every move. After experiencing a profound personal loss, Karen leans on her family for strength and begins to clearly see who's truly in her corner. With her status under pressure and her vulnerability often misunderstood, Karen is learning that sometimes, the only way to get clarity is to stir the pot." 
 Karen Loderick-Peace attends The Fashion Awards 2025 presented by Pandora at the Royal Albert Hall on December 1, 2025 in London, England.
 Photo: Joe Maher/Getty Images for BFC What does Karen Loderick-Peace do for a living?
 According to her Instagram bio , Karen is a fashion designer, founder, and the CEO of the brand, BeCuz.
 Who is Karen Loderick-Peace's husband?
 Karen is married to Jeremy Peace, a British businessman who made his fortune in finance, according to The Telegraph , before going on to become the chairman of the West Bromwich Albion Football Club in the early 2000's. Jeremy departed from his role as chairman in 2016. "My husband has been in the football world for many years, but always remained private," Karen told Grazia . "For me, I had to chat with them all. I talked to God first, then I spoke with them."

 Who are Karen Loderick-Peace's kids?
 Karen has three kids, two daughters who support her on RHOLDN and a son who chooses to remain private. "My son is not on the show," Karen said in her interview with Grazia . "He said, 'Give me some time.' He might or he might not. But my husband and my two girls are supporting me on the show, which is beautiful."
 How to watch Karen Loderick-Peace on The Real Housewives of London 
 Karen has been a cast member on The Real Housewives of London Seasons 1 and 2. All episodes of RHOLondon Season 1 are currently streaming on Peacock .
 Karen Loderick-Peace during The Real Housewives of London Season 1.
 Photo: Bravo What is Karen Loderick-Peace's favorite Real Housewives franchise?
 Karen told Closer in August 2025 that her favorite Real Housewives franchise is The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City . "I love the Salt Lake one because they fight a lot, but they have a quick and easy resolve," she said. "I love that it brings strong, opinionated women, talented women, and women who are not afraid to show their true colors to the world."
